entities.name: Verdura
entities.description: A large forested island in the southern Domains of Dominaria, home to the Verduran Enchantresses.

entities.name: Verduran Enchantresses
entities.description: Spellcasters devoted to the avatar of Verdura.

entities.name: Belbe's Portal
entities.description: A portal in the Dream Halls of Rath that led to Verdura.

entities.name: Takara en-Dal
entities.description: Led by Belbe's Portal to Verdura.

entities.name: Lin Sivvi
entities.description: Led by Belbe's Portal to Verdura.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Led by Belbe's Portal to Verdura.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: Forest the travelers went to defend.

events.summary: In 4205 AR Belbe's Portal leads Takara en-Dal, Lin Sivvi and Eladamri to Verdura, and they travel north to defend Llanowar from the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Belbe's Portal in the Dream Halls of Rath led Takara en-Dal , Lin Sivvi , and Eladamri into the green fields of Verdura.
